about: Vetted AI providers for the free-trial chain (owner decision AI-D19). Read by genai/vetted.py; people read docs/compliance/AI_PROVIDER_REGISTER.md. A new or changed row is a Major AI change. An upstream may answer only when commercial_use is true, trains_on_data is 'no' or 'opt_out_confirmed', and date_checked is under 12 months old (a warning from 6 months). Rows with nulls are not vetted yet: the owner fills them after reading each provider's terms.

providers.notes: Self-hosted router, bound to 127.0.0.1. Only vetted upstream keys are entered in it; its key for MDARIX is scoped to vetted models.
